frame_d8aee8faedb5.question: Vulnerability analysis of USSDRebalancer
artifact_refs: Spot-price dependence in rebalance triggers and valuation
Pool-balance-based trade sizing and susceptibility to temporary liquidity or price manipulation
Public rebalance entry points and whether an attacker can profitably influence trades using flash liquidity or same-block swaps
Interactions between mint-before-sell behavior, configured thresholds, and oracle or pool prices

history.rationale: WHY NOW: USSDRebalancer is an unvisited, high-impact component that directly uses pool slot0 spot prices and pool balances to decide and size trades, while rebalance is publicly callable. These characteristics create a strong price-manipulation surface: a transient pool price could trigger an unfavorable rebalance or distort valuation and trade amounts. EXIT CRITERIA: Trace all rebalance, valuation, buy, and sell paths; identify every price and liquidity input; determine whether prices are spot or time-weighted and whether same-transaction manipulation can affect execution; assess attacker profitability and affected assets; document a concrete exploit path if present, otherwise record why manipulation is economically prevented.
